name: Pirates : Golden Tits
source:
Pirates: Golden Tits - is a game that tells the story of a young pirate captain. 

You will embark on a long journey in search of a family, and many adventures await you along the way. Get ready to spend your precious gold not only on seductive girls, but also on improving your ship, for the best weapons and items that will add variety to the game. 

Play dice, fish, capture ships and share loot with your sailors, hire girls of different professions to your ship. This is just a small part of what you can do in the game.

[From [url=https://hot-bunny.itch.io/pirates-gt]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Pirates: Golden Tits - 是一款讲述年轻海盗船长故事的游戏。

你将踏上寻找家人的漫长旅程，沿途有许多冒险等待着你。准备好将宝贵的金币不仅花在迷人的女孩身上，还可以用来改进你的飞船，以获得最好的武器和物品，为游戏增添多样性。

玩骰子、钓鱼、捕获船只并与水手分享战利品，雇用不同职业的女孩到你的船上。这只是你在游戏中可以做的一小部分。

[来自[url=https://hot-bunny.itch.io/pirates-gt]Itch.io[/url]]
